name: Tests & Publishes to PyPI

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

  push:
    branches:
      - master

  pull_request:

env:
  PROJECT_NAME: mealpy

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.8", "3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 9
          submodules: false

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: setup.py

      - name: Install package and development dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install ".[dev]"

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest \
            --doctest-modules \
            --junitxml=junit/pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml \
            --cov=$PROJECT_NAME \
            --cov-report=xml \
            tests/

      - name: Run Flake8
        run: |
          flake8 tests/

      - name: Upload pytest results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: junit/pytest-results-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          if-no-files-found: warn

      # ============================================================
      # Documentation validation
      # Run only once with Python 3.11
      # ============================================================

      - name: Install documentation dependencies
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m pip install -r docs/requirements.txt

      - name: Generate optimizer classification table
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python scripts/generate_optimizer_table.py --strict

      - name: Build documentation
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m sphinx \
            -E \
            -a \
            --keep-going \
            -b html \
            docs/source \
            docs/_build/html

      # ============================================================
      # Distribution package
      # ============================================================

      - name: Install package builder
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade build twine

      - name: Build distribution package
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        run: |
          python -m build
          python -m twine check --strict dist/*

      - name: Upload distribution package
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.11'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dist-package-3.11
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build

    if: github.event_name == 'release'

    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Download distribution package
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dist-package-3.11
          path: dist

      - name: Publish distribution to TestPyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
        with:
          repository-url: https:/
